expugnable.translation: a. 可突击的, 可攻克的

expulse.definition: v. t. To drive out; to expel.

expulsion.definition: n. the act of expelling or projecting or ejecting
expulsion.translation:
n. 逐出, 开除, 驱逐, 排气
[医] 逼出

expulsions.definition:
n. the act of forcing out someone or something
n. squeezing out by applying pressure
n. the act of expelling or projecting or ejecting
expulsions.translation: n. 喷出( expulsion的复数形式 ); 排出; 开除; 驱逐

expulsive.definition:
a. Having the power of driving out or away; serving to
   expel.
expulsive.translation:
a. 逐出的, 有驱逐权的
[医] 逼出的

expulsive gingivitis.translation: [医] 排出性龈炎, 逼出性龈炎(由于龈炎以致该牙从其槽中渐被逼出)

expulsive stage.translation: [医] 排出期, 第二产程

expunction.definition: n. deletion by an act of expunging or erasing
expunction.translation: n. 消去, 消除, 消灭

expunctuation.translation: n. (古代手稿中)在字母(或词)下打小点表示删去(=expunction)

expunge.definition: v remove by erasing or crossing out or as if by drawing a line
expunge.translation: vt. 擦掉, 删掉, 除去

expunged.translation: v. 擦掉( expunge的过去式和过去分词 ); 除去; 删去; 消除

expunger.translation: vt. 擦去, 拭去, 抹掉, 涂去：；除去；删去, 删除, 勾销, 省略；消除：

expunges.definition: v remove by erasing or crossing out or as if by drawing a line
expunges.translation: v. 擦掉( expunge的第三人称单数 ); 除去; 删去; 消除

expunging.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Expunge
expunging.translation: v. 擦掉( expunge的现在分词 ); 除去; 删去; 消除

expurgate.definition: v edit by omitting or modifying parts considered indelicate
expurgate.translation: vt. 删除, 修订, 使纯洁

expurgated.translation: v. 删除（书等中的）令人反感的成分, 修订, 删去（不当处）( expurgate的过去式和过去分词 )

expurgates.definition: v edit by omitting or modifying parts considered indelicate
expurgates.translation: v. 删除（书等中的）令人反感的成分, 修订, 删去（不当处）( expurgate的第三人称单数 )

expurgating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Expurgate
expurgating.translation: v. 删除（书等中的）令人反感的成分, 修订, 删去（不当处）( expurgate的现在分词 )

expurgation.definition: n. the deletion of objectionable parts from a literary work
expurgation.translation: n. 消去, 删去, 廓清

expurgator.definition: n. a person who edits a text by removing obscene or offensive words or passages
expurgator.translation: n. 削除者, 修订者, 净化文字内容者

expurgatorial.definition: a. Tending or serving to expurgate; expurgatory.
expurgatorial.translation: a. 修订的, 廓清的, 使纯洁的, 删除的, 订正的

expurgatory.definition:
a. Serving to purify from anything noxious or erroneous;
   cleansing; purifying.
expurgatory.translation: a. 修订的, 廓清的, 使纯洁的, 删除的, 订正的
